name: air-hero
title: Air Hero
description: Inspired by the air.inc website design — a cinematic full-screen hero with a looping sky video background, transparent floating navbar, and a 3D spring-tilt product video card. Tab pills (Organize / Approve / Multiply) swap the card video with AnimatePresence fade transitions. Built with motion/react springs (useMotionValue, useSpring) for ±8° rotateX/Y tilt on hover, plus staggered entrance animations on headline, CTA, card, and tabs.
